label: ZKN_SWORD_001_000
text:
There is a plant seed on its back right from the
day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly
grows larger.

label: ZKN_SWORD_002_000
text:
When the bulb on its back grows large, it
appears to lose the ability to stand on its
hind legs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_003_000
text:
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar
energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

label: ZKN_SWORD_004_000
text:
It has a preference for hot things. When it rains,
steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

label: ZKN_SWORD_005_000
text:
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its
fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_006_000
text:
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders.
It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

label: ZKN_SWORD_007_000
text:
When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it
squirts out water with vigorous force.

label: ZKN_SWORD_008_000
text:
It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its
shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

label: ZKN_SWORD_009_000
text:
It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause
fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

label: ZKN_SWORD_010_000
text:
For protection, it releases a horrible stench from
the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_011_000
text:
It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this
stage, it can only harden, so it remains
motionless to avoid attack.

label: ZKN_SWORD_012_000
text:
In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to
release highly toxic dust into the air.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_000
text:
Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity
have cheek sacs that are extra soft and
super stretchy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_026_000
text:
Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself
from its own high-voltage power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_027_000
text:
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas.
By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt
and moisture clinging to its body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_028_000
text:
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder
and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel
when touched.

label: ZKN_SWORD_029_000
text:
Females are more sensitive to smells than males.
While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check
wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

label: ZKN_SWORD_030_000
text:
The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought
that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get
poked while their mother is feeding them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_031_000
text:
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense.
With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield
its children from any kind of attack.

label: ZKN_SWORD_032_000
text:
The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains
a powerful poison. This is a very cautious
Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

label: ZKN_SWORD_033_000
text:
With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this
Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it
searches for a moon stone.

label: ZKN_SWORD_034_000
text:
When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to
control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s
lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

label: ZKN_SWORD_035_000
text:
It is said that happiness will come to those who
see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a
full moon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_036_000
text:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

label: ZKN_SWORD_037_000
text:
While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it
grows, several new tails are sprouted.

label: ZKN_SWORD_038_000
text:
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails
is loaded with supernatural powers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_039_000
text:
Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by
comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop
singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

label: ZKN_SWORD_040_000
text:
The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If
opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate
itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_041_000
text:
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check
its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies
around with skill.

label: ZKN_SWORD_042_000
text:
It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said
that if it finds others of its kind going hungry,
it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.

label: ZKN_SWORD_043_000
text:
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move.
It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

label: ZKN_SWORD_044_000
text:
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.
The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance
of 1.25 miles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_045_000
text:
It has the world’s largest petals. With every step,
the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_050_000
text:
If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil
perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

label: ZKN_SWORD_051_000
text:
A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge
earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

label: ZKN_SWORD_052_000
text:
It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good
mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look
at its hoard of treasures.

label: ZKN_SWORD_053_000
text:
Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you
takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the
moment it gets annoyed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_054_000
text:
Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the
Pokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparently
the pain subsides for a while.

label: ZKN_SWORD_055_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It
paddles through the water with its long limbs,
putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

label: ZKN_SWORD_058_000
text:
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly
stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_059_000
text:
The sight of it running over 6,200 miles
in a single day and night has captivated
many people.

label: ZKN_SWORD_060_000
text:
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking.
The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of
the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

label: ZKN_SWORD_061_000
text:
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness.
This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of
lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

label: ZKN_SWORD_062_000
text:
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through
cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to
smash through drift ice and plow forward.

label: ZKN_SWORD_063_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it
sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the
powers that the Pokémon wields.

label: ZKN_SWORD_064_000
text:
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it
sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

label: ZKN_SWORD_065_000
text:
It has an incredibly high level of intelligence.
Some say that Alakazam remembers everything
that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

label: ZKN_SWORD_066_000
text:
Its whole body is composed of muscles.
Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can
hurl 100 grown-ups.

label: ZKN_SWORD_067_000
text:
Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a
power-save belt to be able to regulate
its motions.

label: ZKN_SWORD_068_000
text:
It quickly swings its four arms to rock its
opponents with ceaseless punches and chops
from all angles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_072_000
text:
Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer.
It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it
searches for prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_073_000
text:
When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow
brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to
fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_077_000
text:
It can’t run properly when it’s newly born.
As it races around with others of its kind,
its legs grow stronger.

label: ZKN_SWORD_078_000
text:
This Pokémon can be seen galloping through
fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane
fluttering in the wind.

label: ZKN_SWORD_079_000
text:
Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t
feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice
when its tail grows back, either.

label: ZKN_SWORD_080_000
text:
Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit
on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail
make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

label: ZKN_SWORD_081_000
text:
At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and
ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a
grounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.

label: ZKN_SWORD_082_000
text:
This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have
linked together. Magneton sends out powerful
radio waves to study its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SWORD_083_000
text:
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves
as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire
situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

label: ZKN_SWORD_090_000
text:
It swims facing backward by opening and closing
its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

label: ZKN_SWORD_091_000
text:
Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered,
even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it
is attacking.

label: ZKN_SWORD_092_000
text:
Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed
by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

label: ZKN_SWORD_093_000
text:
Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim
starts shaking constantly until death
eventually comes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_094_000
text:
On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on
their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.

label: ZKN_SWORD_095_000
text:
As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many
hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

label: ZKN_SWORD_098_000
text:
It can be found near the sea. The large pincers
grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

label: ZKN_SWORD_099_000
text:
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower
strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy
to move.

label: ZKN_SWORD_102_000
text:
Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs,
it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates
with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

label: ZKN_SWORD_103_000
text:
Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking
different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be
very interested in one another.

label: ZKN_SWORD_104_000
text:
When the memory of its departed mother brings
it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the
skull it wears on its head.

label: ZKN_SWORD_105_000
text:
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a
sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents
bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_106_000
text:
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of
balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

label: ZKN_SWORD_107_000
text:
Its punches slice the air. They are launched at
such high speed, even a slight graze could cause
a burn.

label: ZKN_SWORD_108_000
text:
If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and
you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in.
The itch won’t go away, either.

label: ZKN_SWORD_109_000
text:
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into
garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw,
rotting trash.

label: ZKN_SWORD_110_000
text:
It mixes gases between its two bodies.
It’s said that these Pokémon were seen
all over the Galar region back in the day.

label: ZKN_SWORD_111_000
text:
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can
shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_112_000
text:
It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution.
It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

label: ZKN_SWORD_113_000
text:
The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious
but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a
high-class cooking ingredient.

label: ZKN_SWORD_114_000
text:
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows
nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this
Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

label: ZKN_SWORD_115_000
text:
Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on
its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It
intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_116_000
text:
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle
currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits
out pitch-black ink and escapes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_117_000
text:
It’s the males that raise the offspring. While
Seadra are raising young, the spines on their
backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

label: ZKN_SWORD_118_000
text:
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly
in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

label: ZKN_SWORD_119_000
text:
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in
preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on
beautiful colors.

label: ZKN_SWORD_120_000
text:
If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll
be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a
steady rhythm.

label: ZKN_SWORD_121_000
text:
This Pokémon has an organ known as its core.
The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is
unleashing its potent psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_122_000
text:
The broadness of its hands may be no
coincidence—many scientists believe its palms
became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

label: ZKN_SWORD_123_000
text:
As Scyther fights more and more battles, its
scythes become sharper and sharper. With a
single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

label: ZKN_SWORD_124_000
text:
In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared
and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

label: ZKN_SWORD_125_000
text:
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon
around as a defense against Electabuzz that
come seeking electricity.

label: ZKN_SWORD_126_000
text:
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it
regrets this habit once it realizes that it has
burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

label: ZKN_SWORD_127_000
text:
These Pokémon judge one another based on
pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make
for more popularity with the opposite gender.

label: ZKN_SWORD_128_000
text:
When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails,
it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to
charge with astounding speed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_129_000
text:
It is virtually worthless in terms of both power
and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic
Pokémon in the world.

label: ZKN_SWORD_130_000
text:
It has an extremely aggressive nature.
The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth
totally incinerates all targets.

label: ZKN_SWORD_131_000
text:
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon,
it glides across the surface of the sea while
its beautiful song echoes around it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_132_000
text:
It can reconstitute its entire cellular
structure to change into what it sees,
but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_133_000
text:
It has the ability to alter the composition of its
body to suit its surrounding environment.

label: ZKN_SWORD_134_000
text:
When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a
sign that rain will come within a few hours.

label: ZKN_SWORD_135_000
text:
If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its
body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_136_000
text:
Once it has stored up enough heat, this
Pokémon’s body temperature can reach up to
1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_137_000
text:
State-of-the-art technology was used to create
Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be
created via computer programming.

label: ZKN_SWORD_138_000
text:
Because some Omanyte manage to escape after
being restored or are released into the wild by
people, this species is becoming a problem.

label: ZKN_SWORD_139_000
text:
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,
Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it
went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

label: ZKN_SWORD_140_000
text:
This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto
molt every three days, making their shells harder
and harder.

label: ZKN_SWORD_141_000
text:
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out
the fluids. The discarded body parts become
food for other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_142_000
text:
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times.
Apparently even modern technology is incapable
of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_143_000
text:
It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds
of food every day. When it is done eating, it
goes promptly to sleep.

label: ZKN_SWORD_144_000
text:
It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings
are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy
mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_145_000
text:
This Pokémon has complete control over
electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in
the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

label: ZKN_SWORD_146_000
text:
It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When
Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with
a dazzling red glow.

label: ZKN_SWORD_147_000
text:
Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing
water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls.
As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

label: ZKN_SWORD_148_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes.
It can control the weather, and it uses this power
to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

label: ZKN_SWORD_149_000
text:
It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning
person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must
help them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_150_000
text:
Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a
dangerous combination of overwhelming power
and a savage heart.

label: ZKN_SWORD_151_000
text:
It’s very intelligent and can use an incredible
variety of moves. Many believe that all other
Pokémon are descendants of this one.

label: ZKN_SWORD_163_000
text:
It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so
fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_164_000
text:
Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to
see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

label: ZKN_SWORD_169_000
text:
Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a
sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and
sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.

label: ZKN_SWORD_170_000
text:
Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both
positive and negative charges flowing through them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_171_000
text:
The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate
the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_172_000
text:
Despite its small size, it can zap even adult
humans. However, if it does so, it also
surprises itself.

label: ZKN_SWORD_173_000
text:
According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen
in places where shooting stars have fallen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_174_000
text:
Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body
gives off a faint sweet smell.

label: ZKN_SWORD_175_000
text:
The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said
that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_176_000
text:
They say that it will appear before kindhearted,
caring people and shower them with happiness.

label: ZKN_SWORD_177_000
text:
It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and
likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

label: ZKN_SWORD_178_000
text:
They say that it stays still and quiet because it is
seeing both the past and future at the same time.

label: ZKN_SWORD_182_000
text:
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals
rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

label: ZKN_SWORD_183_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The
ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that
have been turned into an oil.

label: ZKN_SWORD_184_000
text:
It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny
days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water
and sunbathes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_185_000
text:
If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s
a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

label: ZKN_SWORD_186_000
text:
At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores
of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by
letting out cries that sound like shouting.

label: ZKN_SWORD_194_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the
water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

label: ZKN_SWORD_195_000
text:
It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it
bumps its head on boats and boulders
while swimming.

label: ZKN_SWORD_196_000
text:
By reading air currents, it can predict things such
as the weather or its foe’s next move.

label: ZKN_SWORD_197_000
text:
When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores
secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at
its opponent’s eyes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_199_000
text:
Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent
intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison
raced through its brain.

label: ZKN_SWORD_202_000
text:
It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its
body to pump up its counterstrike.

label: ZKN_SWORD_206_000
text:
This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists
saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky
in ancient times.

label: ZKN_SWORD_208_000
text:
It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years,
its composition changes to become diamond-like.

label: ZKN_SWORD_211_000
text:
When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows
as much water as it can to match the
opponent’s size.

label: ZKN_SWORD_212_000
text:
Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’s
body weight. A single swing of one of these
pincers will crush a boulder completely.

label: ZKN_SWORD_213_000
text:
It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks,
it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

label: ZKN_SWORD_214_000
text:
Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking
through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two
antennae to pick up scents as it searches.

label: ZKN_SWORD_215_000
text:
Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it
suddenly extends the claws and startles
its enemy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_220_000
text:
It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up
food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_221_000
text:
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back
stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

label: ZKN_SWORD_222_000
text:
It will regrow any branches that break off its
head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola
branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

label: ZKN_SWORD_223_000
text:
The water they shoot from their mouths can hit
moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

label: ZKN_SWORD_224_000
text:
It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It
prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from
them before attacking.

label: ZKN_SWORD_225_000
text:
It carries food all day long. There are tales about
lost people who were saved by the food it had.

label: ZKN_SWORD_226_000
text:
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it
can jump out above the waves and glide
for over 300 feet.

label: ZKN_SWORD_227_000
text:
The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are
sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight
fight viciously over territory.

label: ZKN_SWORD_230_000
text:
With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon
will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra
and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

label: ZKN_SWORD_233_000
text:
This is a Porygon that was updated with special
data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about
many different subjects all on its own.

label: ZKN_SWORD_236_000
text:
It is always bursting with energy. To make itself
stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

label: ZKN_SWORD_237_000
text:
It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high
speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

label: ZKN_SWORD_238_000
text:
If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will
bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty,
Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

label: ZKN_SWORD_239_000
text:
When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets
restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder,
it gets full-on rowdy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_240_000
text:
This Pokémon is still small and timid.
Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised,
flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

label: ZKN_SWORD_241_000
text:
Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s
been supporting the lives of people and other
Pokémon since ancient times.

label: ZKN_SWORD_242_000
text:
Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon,
it will share its egg and offer its care until the
other Pokémon is all better.

label: ZKN_SWORD_246_000
text:
Born deep underground, it comes
aboveground and becomes a pupa once it
has finished eating the surrounding soil.

label: ZKN_SWORD_247_000
text:
Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely.
Hard and fast, it has outstanding
destructive power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_248_000
text:
Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack,
so it is very eager to make challenges
against enemies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_251_000
text:
This Pokémon has the ability to move through
time. Records describing it as a forest deity can
be found from many different eras.

label: ZKN_SWORD_263_000
text:
It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on
trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and
calmer than the kind native to Galar.

label: ZKN_SWORD_264_000
text:
Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes
made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

label: ZKN_SWORD_270_000
text:
It searches about for clean water. If it does not
drink water for too long, the leaf on its
head wilts.

label: ZKN_SWORD_271_000
text:
It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall.
It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow
in the riverbed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_272_000
text:
The rhythm of bright, festive music activates
Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.

label: ZKN_SWORD_273_000
text:
If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut.
It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_274_000
text:
It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head,
it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_275_000
text:
A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian.
It can read the foe’s mind and take
preemptive action.

label: ZKN_SWORD_278_000
text:
It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea
breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_279_000
text:
It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small
Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

label: ZKN_SWORD_280_000
text:
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people
and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

label: ZKN_SWORD_281_000
text:
If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with
energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

label: ZKN_SWORD_282_000
text:
It has the power to predict the future. Its power
peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

label: ZKN_SWORD_290_000
text:
Because it lived almost entirely underground,
it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

label: ZKN_SWORD_291_000
text:
Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too
long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

label: ZKN_SWORD_292_000
text:
A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears
in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_293_000
text:
The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels.
If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a
cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.

label: ZKN_SWORD_294_000
text:
Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can
put out sound waves powerful enough to blow
away a house.

label: ZKN_SWORD_295_000
text:
In the past, people would use the loud voices of
these Pokémon as a means of communication
between distant cities.

label: ZKN_SWORD_298_000
text:
The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber
ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon
needs to grow.

label: ZKN_SWORD_302_000
text:
This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes
begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed
that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

label: ZKN_SWORD_303_000
text:
It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into
complacency, then bites with its huge,
relentless jaws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_304_000
text:
It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—
to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_305_000
text:
Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring
water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often
came into conflict with humans in the past.

label: ZKN_SWORD_306_000
text:
Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate
thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by
ramming into them horn first.

label: ZKN_SWORD_309_000
text:
It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging.
It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

label: ZKN_SWORD_310_000
text:
It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so
it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with
electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

label: ZKN_SWORD_315_000
text:
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.
The stronger its aroma, the healthier
the Roselia is.

label: ZKN_SWORD_318_000
text:
It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it
spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to
join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

label: ZKN_SWORD_319_000
text:
As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo
will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling
toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

label: ZKN_SWORD_320_000
text:
It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from
the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of
Wishiwashi every day.

label: ZKN_SWORD_321_000
text:
It can sometimes knock out opponents
with the shock created by breaching and
crashing its big body onto the water.

label: ZKN_SWORD_324_000
text:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows
out black soot if it is endangered.

label: ZKN_SWORD_328_000
text:
Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert.
Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

label: ZKN_SWORD_329_000
text:
The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its
two wings together cause severe headaches.

label: ZKN_SWORD_330_000
text:
This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms
it creates and seldom appears where people
can see it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_333_000
text:
Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light
and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care
of its wings.

label: ZKN_SWORD_334_000
text:
As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria
performs a humming song that would enrapture
any audience.

label: ZKN_SWORD_337_000
text:
The phase of the moon apparently has some
effect on its power. It’s active on the night of
a full moon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_338_000
text:
When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to
the sun, thus blinding its foes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_339_000
text:
Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is
said to have been born from hardened mud.

label: ZKN_SWORD_340_000
text:
It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will
eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_341_000
text:
No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will
adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

label: ZKN_SWORD_342_000
text:
A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws.
It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

label: ZKN_SWORD_343_000
text:
It moves while spinning around on its single foot.
Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on
their heads.

label: ZKN_SWORD_344_000
text:
This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient
clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

label: ZKN_SWORD_345_000
text:
This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.
Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed
approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

label: ZKN_SWORD_346_000
text:
It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its
neck and tentacles can extend to over three
times their usual length to nab distant prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_347_000
text:
This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.
Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000
years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_348_000
text:
After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto
land. Its lower body has become stronger, and
blows from its tail are devastating.

label: ZKN_SWORD_349_000
text:
Although unattractive and unpopular, this
Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a
subject of research.

label: ZKN_SWORD_350_000
text:
Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists.
It has even been referred to as the most
beautiful Pokémon of all.

label: ZKN_SWORD_355_000
text:
If it finds bad children who won’t listen to their
parents, it will spirit them away—or so it’s said.

label: ZKN_SWORD_356_000
text:
Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its
mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a
black hole.

label: ZKN_SWORD_359_000
text:
Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and
mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely
sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

label: ZKN_SWORD_360_000
text:
It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash
against one another to toughen their spirits.

label: ZKN_SWORD_361_000
text:
It’s said that if they are seen at midnight, they’ll
cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice
to survive.

label: ZKN_SWORD_362_000
text:
It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with
fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in
the atmosphere.

label: ZKN_SWORD_363_000
text:
This Pokémon’s body is covered in blubber and
impressively round. It’s faster for Spheal to roll
around than walk.

label: ZKN_SWORD_364_000
text:
Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming
when they’re on the hunt, seeking out their prey
by scent.

label: ZKN_SWORD_365_000
text:
Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals.
When a threat appears, the herd’s leader will
protect the group with its life.

label: ZKN_SWORD_369_000
text:
Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders
allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water
pressure of the deep sea.

label: ZKN_SWORD_371_000
text:
Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to
grow stronger so that someday it will be able
to fly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_372_000
text:
This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard
shell that has the same composition as bone.
Shelgon stores energy for evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_373_000
text:
Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it
was able to evolve a body with wings just by
constantly wishing to be able to fly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_374_000
text:
From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that
rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on
Beldum’s sharp claws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_375_000
text:
Two Beldum have become stuck together via
their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the
resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_376_000
text:
Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon
get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross
living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_377_000
text:
Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone.
As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks
rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.

label: ZKN_SWORD_378_000
text:
With cold air that can reach temperatures as low
as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly
freezes any creature that approaches it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_379_000
text:
Registeel’s body is made of a strange material
that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but
also more durable than any metal.

label: ZKN_SWORD_385_000
text:
Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure
voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-
perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

label: ZKN_SWORD_403_000
text:
This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting
its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx
is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

label: ZKN_SWORD_404_000
text:
By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this
Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’s
electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

label: ZKN_SWORD_405_000
text:
Luxray can see through solid objects. It will
instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls,
even if the walls are thick.

label: ZKN_SWORD_406_000
text:
The pollen it releases contains poison. If this
Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s
toxicity is increased.

label: ZKN_SWORD_407_000
text:
After captivating opponents with its sweet scent,
it lashes them with its thorny whips.

label: ZKN_SWORD_415_000
text:
The members of the trio spend all their time
together. Each one has a slightly different taste
in nectar.

label: ZKN_SWORD_416_000
text:
It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its
enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives
to defend Vespiquen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_420_000
text:
It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked
by bird Pokémon that would love to make off
with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

label: ZKN_SWORD_421_000
text:
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly
waiting for sunlight to appear.

label: ZKN_SWORD_422_000
text:
This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique.
According to some theories, life in warm ocean
waters causes this variation to develop.

label: ZKN_SWORD_423_000
text:
Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land,
where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it
passes through.

label: ZKN_SWORD_425_000
text:
Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children.
However, it often quickly runs away again when
the children play too roughly with it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_426_000
text:
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls
burdened with regrets, silently drifting through
the dusk.

label: ZKN_SWORD_427_000
text:
If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something
is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the
Pokémon is in need of care.

label: ZKN_SWORD_428_000
text:
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings.
If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds
with superdestructive kicks.

label: ZKN_SWORD_434_000
text:
From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at
opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit
them from over 16 feet away.

label: ZKN_SWORD_435_000
text:
In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots
from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet
varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

label: ZKN_SWORD_436_000
text:
It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its
body doesn’t come from any culture in the
Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

label: ZKN_SWORD_437_000
text:
Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain
clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry
that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

label: ZKN_SWORD_438_000
text:
It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes.
The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have
a slight bitterness.

label: ZKN_SWORD_439_000
text:
It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra
effort into copying the graceful dance steps
of Mr. Rime as practice.

label: ZKN_SWORD_440_000
text:
Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg-
shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will
treasure this stone.

label: ZKN_SWORD_442_000
text:
Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this
Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured
spirits in the mix.

label: ZKN_SWORD_443_000
text:
Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides
of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way,
Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

label: ZKN_SWORD_444_000
text:
This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a
protrusion on either side of its head to probe
pitch-dark caves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_445_000
text:
Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains.
It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane,
hunting down as much prey as it can.

label: ZKN_SWORD_446_000
text:
Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its
only concern. Whether the food is rotten or
fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.

label: ZKN_SWORD_447_000
text:
It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina
to keep running all through the night. Taking it
for walks can be a challenging experience.

label: ZKN_SWORD_448_000
text:
It controls waves known as auras, which are
powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks.
It uses these waves to take down its prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_449_000
text:
It moves through the sands with its mouth open,
swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of
the sand by spouting it from its nose.

label: ZKN_SWORD_450_000
text:
Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies.
Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so
Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_451_000
text:
After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently
for prey to come near. This Pokémon and
Sizzlipede share common descent.

label: ZKN_SWORD_452_000
text:
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This
Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead,
going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

label: ZKN_SWORD_453_000
text:
It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled
cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk
hits them with a poison jab.

label: ZKN_SWORD_454_000
text:
It bounces toward opponents and gouges them
with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch
is needed to knock out its adversaries.

label: ZKN_SWORD_458_000
text:
Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat
sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this
region may be the cause.

label: ZKN_SWORD_459_000
text:
It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into
the snow to absorb water and keep its own
temperature down.

label: ZKN_SWORD_460_000
text:
If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after
Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable
arms like hammers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_461_000
text:
They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large
as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of
a group of Weavile.

label: ZKN_SWORD_462_000
text:
Some say that Magnezone receives signals from
space via the antenna on its head and that it’s
being controlled by some mysterious being.

label: ZKN_SWORD_463_000
text:
Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many
times the length of its body. No one has figured
out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.

label: ZKN_SWORD_464_000
text:
It can load up to three projectiles per arm into
the holes in its hands. What launches out of those
holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

label: ZKN_SWORD_465_000
text:
Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it
pleases. Recent research has shown that these
arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

label: ZKN_SWORD_466_000
text:
The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon
produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse.
The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

label: ZKN_SWORD_467_000
text:
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning
in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to
over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_468_000
text:
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near
conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly
been seen at all.

label: ZKN_SWORD_470_000
text:
Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts
from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular
perfume made using that scent.

label: ZKN_SWORD_471_000
text:
Any who become captivated by the beauty of
the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen
before they know it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_473_000
text:
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings
from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a
while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

label: ZKN_SWORD_474_000
text:
Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to
move between dimensions, but the program also
caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.

label: ZKN_SWORD_475_000
text:
True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses
the blades on its elbows only in defense of
something or someone.

label: ZKN_SWORD_477_000
text:
At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit
world, it steals people and Pokémon away.
No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

label: ZKN_SWORD_478_000
text:
After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain,
her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon
was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_000
text:
One boy’s invention led to the development of
many different machines that take advantage of
Rotom’s unique capabilities.

label: ZKN_SWORD_506_000
text:
This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious.
It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect
information about its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SWORD_507_000
text:
Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon.
So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was
the first Pokémon to partner with people.

label: ZKN_SWORD_508_000
text:
These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans.
Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up
to people in about three days.

label: ZKN_SWORD_509_000
text:
It steals things from people just to amuse itself
with their frustration. A rivalry exists between
this Pokémon and Nickit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_510_000
text:
Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant
figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_517_000
text:
Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows.
As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body
give off a faint glow.

label: ZKN_SWORD_518_000
text:
When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t
get too near. If you do, your nightmares will
become reality.

label: ZKN_SWORD_519_000
text:
Where people go, these Pokémon follow.
If you’re scattering food for them, be careful—
several hundred of them can gather at once.

label: ZKN_SWORD_520_000
text:
It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far
it travels, it can always find its way back to its
master and its nest.

label: ZKN_SWORD_521_000
text:
Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females
are known for their stamina, while the males
outclass them in terms of speed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_524_000
text:
It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in
water will cause it to soften a bit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_525_000
text:
If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be
wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_526_000
text:
This hardy Pokémon can often be found on
construction sites and in mines, working
alongside people and Copperajah.

label: ZKN_SWORD_527_000
text:
While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots
of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s
evidence that Woobat live there.

label: ZKN_SWORD_528_000
text:
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out.
Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a
little while.

label: ZKN_SWORD_529_000
text:
It brings its claws together and whirls around at
high speed before rushing toward its prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_530_000
text:
It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to
have formed naturally to actually be a result
of Excadrill’s rampant digging.

label: ZKN_SWORD_531_000
text:
Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a
pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape
Audino’s ears.

label: ZKN_SWORD_532_000
text:
It loves helping out with construction projects.
It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt,
it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

label: ZKN_SWORD_533_000
text:
It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other
Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other
Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

label: ZKN_SWORD_534_000
text:
Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more
durable than normal concrete, even when the
compositions of the two materials are the same.

label: ZKN_SWORD_535_000
text:
Graceful ripples running across the water’s
surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing
in high-pitched voices below.

label: ZKN_SWORD_536_000
text:
It weakens its prey with sound waves intense
enough to cause headaches, then entangles
them with its sticky tongue.

label: ZKN_SWORD_537_000
text:
The vibrating of the bumps all over its body
causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and
Croagunk are similar species.

label: ZKN_SWORD_538_000
text:
It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill.
Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt
grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

label: ZKN_SWORD_539_000
text:
If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its
single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to
quietly pass by.

label: ZKN_SWORD_543_000
text:
Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species,
but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

label: ZKN_SWORD_544_000
text:
This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into
its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

label: ZKN_SWORD_545_000
text:
Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on
its neck before slamming them into the ground
and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_546_000
text:
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

label: ZKN_SWORD_547_000
text:
It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If
it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and
have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

label: ZKN_SWORD_548_000
text:
Petilil appears around sources of clean water.
Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in
a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.

label: ZKN_SWORD_549_000
text:
It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a
hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head
to bloom.

label: ZKN_SWORD_550_000
text:
Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on
the hook. And there are always more to catch—
many people release them into lakes illicitly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_551_000
text:
The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun
sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand
and sleeps until sunrise.

label: ZKN_SWORD_552_000
text:
Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to
see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in
the dead of night without getting lost.

label: ZKN_SWORD_553_000
text:
This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands.
Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy
plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

label: ZKN_SWORD_554_000
text:
It derives its power from fire burning inside
its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will
immediately fall asleep.

label: ZKN_SWORD_555_000
text:
The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon
can deliver punches capable of obliterating a
dump truck.

label: ZKN_SWORD_556_000
text:
With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles
of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling
bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

label: ZKN_SWORD_557_000
text:
When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole
inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is
the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_558_000
text:
This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry
climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on
rainy days.

label: ZKN_SWORD_559_000
text:
If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and
no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this
troublesome Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_560_000
text:
As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem,
they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s
concrete pillars.

label: ZKN_SWORD_561_000
text:
Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some
say they were the guardians of an ancient city.
Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

label: ZKN_SWORD_562_000
text:
It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask
that’s said to have been the face it had when it
was still human.

label: ZKN_SWORD_563_000
text:
This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold.
People say it no longer remembers that it was
once human.

label: ZKN_SWORD_564_000
text:
This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although
it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in
search of prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_565_000
text:
Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones,
shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own
shell grows thick and sturdy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_566_000
text:
This Pokémon was successfully restored from a
fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable
to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.

label: ZKN_SWORD_567_000
text:
It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops
wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph,
building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_568_000
text:
Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you
leave trash lying around, you could even find
one of these Pokémon living in your room.

label: ZKN_SWORD_569_000
text:
This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison
inside its body. The main component of the
poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

label: ZKN_SWORD_570_000
text:
Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems
to be what led to the development of Zorua’s
ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

label: ZKN_SWORD_571_000
text:
This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its
kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to
keep its den and pack safe.

label: ZKN_SWORD_572_000
text:
The way it brushes away grime with its tail
can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on
spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_573_000
text:
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads
over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust.
Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

label: ZKN_SWORD_574_000
text:
Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic
power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and
sometimes they use that power to fight.

label: ZKN_SWORD_575_000
text:
It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky,
this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children.
Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

label: ZKN_SWORD_576_000
text:
It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes
conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based
on the movement of the stars.

label: ZKN_SWORD_577_000
text:
It communicates with others telepathically.
Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes
a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

label: ZKN_SWORD_578_000
text:
Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range
of more than half a mile—but only if its two
brains can agree with each other.

label: ZKN_SWORD_579_000
text:
While it could use its psychic abilities in battle,
this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms
around to beat opponents into submission.

label: ZKN_SWORD_582_000
text:
Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself
comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to
cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

label: ZKN_SWORD_583_000
text:
By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body.
This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with
warm, sunny weather.

label: ZKN_SWORD_584_000
text:
When its anger reaches a breaking point, this
Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes
every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

label: ZKN_SWORD_587_000
text:
As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles
with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can
cause a lot of trouble.

label: ZKN_SWORD_588_000
text:
Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy
in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet
will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

label: ZKN_SWORD_589_000
text:
They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet
to arm and protect themselves. They’re very
popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_590_000
text:
No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on
Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_591_000
text:
This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes.
If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll
grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

label: ZKN_SWORD_592_000
text:
It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws
it down to the deeps, five miles below the
ocean’s surface.

label: ZKN_SWORD_593_000
text:
Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is
identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships
its lair.

label: ZKN_SWORD_595_000
text:
Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon.
It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t
produce a charge on its own.

label: ZKN_SWORD_596_000
text:
It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its
means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could
be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

label: ZKN_SWORD_597_000
text:
It defends itself by launching spikes, but its
aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of
practice will it improve.

label: ZKN_SWORD_598_000
text:
This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks,
and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb
the nutrients it finds within the stone.

label: ZKN_SWORD_599_000
text:
The two minigears that compose this Pokémon
are closer than twins. They mesh well only with
each other.

label: ZKN_SWORD_600_000
text:
When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up
perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and
this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.

label: ZKN_SWORD_601_000
text:
From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of
electricity. Its red core contains an enormous
amount of energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_605_000
text:
If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery
will appear on the screen. That scenery is said
to be from its home.

label: ZKN_SWORD_606_000
text:
Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm,
a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

label: ZKN_SWORD_607_000
text:
The flame on its head keeps its body slightly
warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the
hand to guide them to the spirit world.

label: ZKN_SWORD_608_000
text:
This Pokémon appears just before someone
passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary
of death.

label: ZKN_SWORD_609_000
text:
This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions.
It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with
the ominous dancing of its flames.

label: ZKN_SWORD_610_000
text:
These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their
tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is
also how they test each other’s strength.

label: ZKN_SWORD_611_000
text:
After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its
tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its
tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

label: ZKN_SWORD_612_000
text:
Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up
dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its
tusks in top condition.

label: ZKN_SWORD_613_000
text:
When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot
becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot
on anyone it doesn’t like.

label: ZKN_SWORD_614_000
text:
It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey.
From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that
are harder than steel.

label: ZKN_SWORD_615_000
text:
With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it
encounters. It then takes its victims away to
somewhere unknown.

label: ZKN_SWORD_616_000
text:
When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell.
This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast,
however, because they can still get into the shell.

label: ZKN_SWORD_617_000
text:
It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at
foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is
a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

label: ZKN_SWORD_618_000
text:
Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with
it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to
generate electricity.

label: ZKN_SWORD_619_000
text:
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop
with its arms more than 100 times.

label: ZKN_SWORD_620_000
text:
When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging
opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the
fur on its arms.

label: ZKN_SWORD_621_000
text:
Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips
sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body
gets too cold.

label: ZKN_SWORD_622_000
text:
They were sculpted from clay in ancient times.
No one knows why, but some of them are driven
to continually line up boulders.

label: ZKN_SWORD_623_000
text:
Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient
castles served as perches from which Golurk
could fire energy beams.

label: ZKN_SWORD_624_000
text:
It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges
of the blades covering its body. These sharpened
blades allow it to bring down opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_625_000
text:
It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard.
Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring
none of them even think of double-crossing it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_626_000
text:
These Pokémon can crush a car with no more
than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on
their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

label: ZKN_SWORD_627_000
text:
If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist
challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses,
it starts bawling.

label: ZKN_SWORD_628_000
text:
Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic
Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various
kinds of emblems.

label: ZKN_SWORD_629_000
text:
It wears a bone to protect its rear.
It often squabbles with others of its kind over
particularly comfy bones.

label: ZKN_SWORD_630_000
text:
Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will
take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them
till they’re ready to leave the nest.

label: ZKN_SWORD_631_000
text:
There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in
the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the
hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

label: ZKN_SWORD_632_000
text:
They lay their eggs deep inside their nests.
When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate
using their massive mandibles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_633_000
text:
When it encounters something, its first urge is
usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will
commit the associated scent to memory.

label: ZKN_SWORD_634_000
text:
While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its
territory, its two heads often bickering over
which way to go.

label: ZKN_SWORD_635_000
text:
There are a slew of stories about villages that
were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything
that moves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_636_000
text:
The people of ancient times believed that
Larvesta fell from the sun.

label: ZKN_SWORD_637_000
text:
Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it
does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to
rescue those that suffer in the cold.

label: ZKN_SWORD_638_000
text:
This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside
Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in
defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_639_000
text:
It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush
anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_640_000
text:
A legend tells of this Pokémon working
together with Cobalion and Terrakion to
protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_643_000
text:
Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the
sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon
will scorch the world.

label: ZKN_SWORD_644_000
text:
When the interior part of its tail spins like a
motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of
lightning to blast its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SWORD_646_000
text:
Dwelling within it is a power even greater than
that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme
cold keeps that power bound.

label: ZKN_SWORD_647_000
text:
Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this
Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world,
seeking more opportunities to further its training.

label: ZKN_SWORD_659_000
text:
It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can
dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

label: ZKN_SWORD_660_000
text:
With power equal to an excavator, it can dig
through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during
tunnel construction.

label: ZKN_SWORD_661_000
text:
Its melodious cries are actually warnings.
Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything
that enters its territory.

label: ZKN_SWORD_662_000
text:
Fletchinder launches embers into the den of
its prey. When the prey comes leaping out,
Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.

label: ZKN_SWORD_663_000
text:
Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird
Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends
embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_674_000
text:
It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then
imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns
to battle and hunt for prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_675_000
text:
This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no
problem using its prodigious strength to get its
way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_677_000
text:
Though Espurr’s expression never changes,
behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to
contain its devastating psychic power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_678_000
text:
Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of
its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally
keeps the patterns hidden, however.

label: ZKN_SWORD_679_000
text:
Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who
was killed a long time ago by the sword that
makes up Honedge’s body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_680_000
text:
Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades
rub together to emit a metallic sound that
unnerves opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_681_000
text:
In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel
body and a force field of spectral power to
reduce the damage of any attack.

label: ZKN_SWORD_682_000
text:
A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allows
it to create various scents. A change in its diet
will alter the fragrance it produces.

label: ZKN_SWORD_683_000
text:
The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so
powerful that this Pokémon’s companions will
eventually lose their sense of smell.

label: ZKN_SWORD_684_000
text:
It eats its own weight in sugar every day.
If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes
incredibly grumpy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_685_000
text:
By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their
mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that
this skill will have many medical applications.

label: ZKN_SWORD_686_000
text:
It spins while making its luminescent spots flash.
These spots allow it to communicate with others
by using different patterns of light.

label: ZKN_SWORD_687_000
text:
Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly
induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer
under Malamar’s control.

label: ZKN_SWORD_688_000
text:
After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they
adhere themselves to it and live together.
They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

label: ZKN_SWORD_689_000
text:
Seven Binacle come together to form one
Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head
gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_690_000
text:
It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating
seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on
the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

label: ZKN_SWORD_691_000
text:
Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of
corroding metal to send tankers that enter its
territory to the bottom of the sea.

label: ZKN_SWORD_692_000
text:
Clauncher’s claws can fall off during battle, but
they’ll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is
popular as a delicacy in Galar.

label: ZKN_SWORD_693_000
text:
After using the feelers on its oversized claw to
detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches
a cannonball of water at its target.

label: ZKN_SWORD_694_000
text:
When spread, the frills on its head act like solar
panels, generating the power behind this
Pokémon’s electric moves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_695_000
text:
A now-vanished desert culture treasured these
Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to
the Galar region, treasure came with them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_696_000
text:
This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern
times. It has a violent disposition, and it’ll tear
apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_697_000
text:
This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000
years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious
but magnificent.

label: ZKN_SWORD_698_000
text:
This Pokémon was successfully restored from a
fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind
in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

label: ZKN_SWORD_699_000
text:
Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that
when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the
night sky.

label: ZKN_SWORD_700_000
text:
By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its
ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

label: ZKN_SWORD_701_000
text:
It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile
maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy
finishing move.

label: ZKN_SWORD_702_000
text:
A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical waves
other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share
locations of food or electricity with one another.

label: ZKN_SWORD_703_000
text:
When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all
out by firing high-energy beams from the gems
embedded in its body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_704_000
text:
Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if
the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered
the weakest dragon Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_705_000
text:
Although this Pokémon isn’t very strong, its body
is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through
anything, so predators steer clear of it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_706_000
text:
Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and
appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers
don’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.

label: ZKN_SWORD_707_000
text:
This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys.
Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the
Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

label: ZKN_SWORD_708_000
text:
After a lost child perished in the forest, their
spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s
rebirth as this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_709_000
text:
People fear it due to a belief that it devours any
who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the
Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

label: ZKN_SWORD_710_000
text:
Spirits that wander this world are placed into
Pumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on to
the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SWORD_711_000
text:
Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of
night. The sounds are said to be the wails of
spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SWORD_712_000
text:
They chill the air around them to −150 degrees
Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice
that they use as armor.

label: ZKN_SWORD_713_000
text:
At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found
with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims
among the icebergs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_714_000
text:
After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they
nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic
waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_715_000
text:
Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly
torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

label: ZKN_SWORD_722_000
text:
At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while
flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet
switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

label: ZKN_SWORD_723_000
text:
It throws one knifelike feather after another at its
enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak
point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

label: ZKN_SWORD_724_000
text:
As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills
hidden among the feathers of its wings.
Decidueye’s shots never miss.

label: ZKN_SWORD_725_000
text:
It spends even the smallest amount of downtime
grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers
in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_726_000
text:
In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on
Torracat’s neck rings like a bell and produces
stronger flames than usual.

label: ZKN_SWORD_727_000
text:
It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles.
The temperature of the flames that issue from its
navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_728_000
text:
It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its
opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer
force of their bursting is what deals damage.

label: ZKN_SWORD_729_000
text:
As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its
enemies. All the while, it’s busy forming a bunch
of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_730_000
text:
With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound
like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to
control its water balloons.

label: ZKN_SWORD_736_000
text:
Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may
flee rather than risk getting caught in its large
mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

label: ZKN_SWORD_737_000
text:
While its durable shell protects it from attacks,
Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of
electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_738_000
text:
It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it
through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off
in concentrated beams.

label: ZKN_SWORD_742_000
text:
Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can
find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying
to get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.

label: ZKN_SWORD_743_000
text:
It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar.
The puffs’ effects depend on the type of
ingredients and how much of each one is used.

label: ZKN_SWORD_744_000
text:
This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its
Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising
a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

label: ZKN_SWORD_745_000
text:
This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks
jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

label: ZKN_SWORD_746_000
text:
Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by
gathering up into schools that they’re able
to confront opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_747_000
text:
The first symptom of its sting is numbness.
The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’s
impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

label: ZKN_SWORD_748_000
text:
To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this
Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing
its body so it can capture its own body heat.

label: ZKN_SWORD_749_000
text:
Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its
own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon.
It’s skilled at making use of mud.

label: ZKN_SWORD_750_000
text:
Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale’s legs
sets harder than stone. It’s so hard that it allows
this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

label: ZKN_SWORD_751_000
text:
It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body
and then covers its head with it. Meeting another
Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

label: ZKN_SWORD_752_000
text:
It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning
prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then
take its time to savor its meal.

label: ZKN_SWORD_753_000
text:
When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a
pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug
Pokémon to gather around it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_754_000
text:
This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower.
A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous,
brilliant colors.

label: ZKN_SWORD_755_000
text:
Pokémon living in the forest eat the
delicious caps on Morelull’s head.
The caps regrow overnight.

label: ZKN_SWORD_756_000
text:
Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to
sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing,
it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

label: ZKN_SWORD_757_000
text:
Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this
Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail.
This process creates Salandit’s poisonous gas.

label: ZKN_SWORD_758_000
text:
Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden
with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_759_000
text:
Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly
reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result
in painful retaliation.

label: ZKN_SWORD_760_000
text:
Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show
its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is
dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

label: ZKN_SWORD_761_000
text:
Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is
extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_762_000
text:
As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads
out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will
feel a surge of happiness.

label: ZKN_SWORD_763_000
text:
This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and
a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on
its opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_764_000
text:
Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates
itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t
wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_765_000
text:
With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its
own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to
other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_766_000
text:
Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the
orders of their boss as they all help out in the
search for their favorite berries.

label: ZKN_SWORD_767_000
text:
It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and
everything, including garbage and rotten things.
The ground near its nest is always clean.

label: ZKN_SWORD_768_000
text:
It will do anything to win, taking advantage of
every opening and finishing opponents off with
the small claws on its front legs.

label: ZKN_SWORD_769_000
text:
Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of
sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond
of the shovel on its head.

label: ZKN_SWORD_770_000
text:
Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It
pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling
the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

label: ZKN_SWORD_771_000
text:
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a
foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means
to punch them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_772_000
text:
Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research
notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon
being created in the Galar region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_000
text:
A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and
its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within
Silvally. It can change its type at will.

label: ZKN_SWORD_776_000
text:
Explosive substances coat the shell on its back.
Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away
by an immense detonation.

label: ZKN_SWORD_777_000
text:
With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon
takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon.
It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

label: ZKN_SWORD_778_000
text:
It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume
in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately,
the costume only makes it creepier.

label: ZKN_SWORD_780_000
text:
The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles
in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play
with the children living in the towns below.

label: ZKN_SWORD_781_000
text:
After a piece of seaweed merged with debris
from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this
ghost Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_782_000
text:
They learn to fight by smashing their head scales
together. The dueling strengthens both their skills
and their spirits.

label: ZKN_SWORD_783_000
text:
The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are
signs of its strength. It shows them off to
defeated opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_784_000
text:
It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents.
This Pokémon will battle only those who stand
steadfast in the face of this display.

label: ZKN_SWORD_789_000
text:
This Pokémon came from another universe.
Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle
breeze can blow it away.

label: ZKN_SWORD_790_000
text:
The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s
growth. The shell that encases it is harder than
any known material.

label: ZKN_SWORD_791_000
text:
When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon
could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel
any darkness and light up the world.

label: ZKN_SWORD_792_000
text:
Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this
Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and
converting it into its own energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_800_000
text:
It survives by absorbing light. After a long time
spent slumbering underground, impurities
accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

label: ZKN_SWORD_802_000
text:
By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts
master and copying their movements, this
Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

label: ZKN_SWORD_807_000
text:
It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its
opponents with its high-voltage claws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_808_000
text:
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid
metal within its body is how it generates energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_809_000
text:
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and
fall apart. The small shards left behind will
eventually be reborn as Meltan.

label: ZKN_SWORD_810_000
text:
When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat,
the sound waves produced carry revitalizing
energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

label: ZKN_SWORD_811_000
text:
The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm
with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from
its peers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_812_000
text:
By drumming, it taps into the power of its special
tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its
direction in battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_813_000
text:
A warm-up of running around gets fire energy
