coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that
happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_814_000
text:
Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold
and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_815_000
text:
It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a
burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents
hard and leave them scorched.

label: ZKN_SWORD_816_000
text:
When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack
the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers
won’t be able to resist weeping.

label: ZKN_SWORD_817_000
text:
A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using
water balloons created with moisture secreted
from its palms.

label: ZKN_SWORD_818_000
text:
It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips
that can shoot water and a membrane on its back
that it can use to glide through the air.

label: ZKN_SWORD_819_000
text:
Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon
becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely
empty of berries.

label: ZKN_SWORD_820_000
text:
It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that
they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit
slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

label: ZKN_SWORD_821_000
text:
It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter
how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every
battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_822_000
text:
Smart enough to use tools in battle, these
Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and
flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_823_000
text:
This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the
Galar region. The black luster of its steel body
could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

label: ZKN_SWORD_824_000
text:
A constant collector of information, this Pokémon
is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

label: ZKN_SWORD_825_000
text:
It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its
shell without food or water seems to have
awakened its psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_826_000
text:
It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and
the large size of its brain is proof that it also
possesses immense psychic power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_827_000
text:
Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids
the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off
its ill-gotten gains.

label: ZKN_SWORD_828_000
text:
It secretly marks potential targets with a scent.
By following the scent, it stalks its targets
and steals from them when they least expect it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_829_000
text:
It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg,
then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough
sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

label: ZKN_SWORD_830_000
text:
The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of
nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that
plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_831_000
text:
Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that
this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right
back up at the bottom, unharmed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_832_000
text:
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end
up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll
start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_833_000
text:
Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to
snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_834_000
text:
With jaws that can shear through steel rods,
this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down
on its unfortunate prey.

label: ZKN_SWORD_835_000
text:
This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog
in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates
electricity from the base of its tail.

label: ZKN_SWORD_836_000
text:
This Pokémon generates electricity and channels
it into its legs to keep them going strong.
Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

label: ZKN_SWORD_837_000
text:
Most of its body has the same composition as
coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered
in coal mines about 400 years ago.

label: ZKN_SWORD_838_000
text:
It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by
this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of
people in the Galar region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_839_000
text:
It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines
enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with
flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_840_000
text:
It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides
from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by
pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

label: ZKN_SWORD_841_000
text:
It ate a sour apple, and that induced its
evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid
capable of causing chemical burns.

label: ZKN_SWORD_842_000
text:
Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution.
A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in
the bug Pokémon it preys on.

label: ZKN_SWORD_843_000
text:
As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its
neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than
17 pounds of sand.

label: ZKN_SWORD_844_000
text:
When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of
sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of
sand, it becomes disheartened.

label: ZKN_SWORD_845_000
text:
It’s so strong that it can knock out some
opponents in a single hit, but it also may
forget what it’s battling midfight.

label: ZKN_SWORD_846_000
text:
If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon
charges for it straightaway, leading with its
sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

label: ZKN_SWORD_847_000
text:
This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear
and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s
flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

label: ZKN_SWORD_848_000
text:
It stores poison in an internal poison sac and
secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch
this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

label: ZKN_SWORD_849_000
text:
When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a
guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on
its chest to generate electricity.

label: ZKN_SWORD_850_000
text:
It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to
generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly
get particularly hot.

label: ZKN_SWORD_851_000
text:
When it heats up, its body temperature reaches
about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its
body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_852_000
text:
It’s very curious, but its means of investigating
things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.
The search for food is what brings it onto land.

label: ZKN_SWORD_853_000
text:
A body made up of nothing but muscle makes
the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with
its tentacles tremendously powerful.

label: ZKN_SWORD_854_000
text:
This Pokémon is said to have been born when
a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup
of tea.

label: ZKN_SWORD_855_000
text:
This species lives in antique teapots.
Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions,
an authentic work is found.

label: ZKN_SWORD_856_000
text:
Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other
creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm
disposition, it will never warm up to you.

label: ZKN_SWORD_857_000
text:
No matter who you are, if you bring strong
emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence
you violently.

label: ZKN_SWORD_858_000
text:
It emits psychic power strong enough to cause
headaches as a deterrent to the approach
of others.

label: ZKN_SWORD_859_000
text:
Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations
produced by people and Pokémon when they
feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_860_000
text:
When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for
forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so
that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

label: ZKN_SWORD_861_000
text:
With the hair wrapped around its body helping to
enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm
even Machamp.

label: ZKN_SWORD_862_000
text:
Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon
has a tendency to take on a threatening posture
and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

label: ZKN_SWORD_863_000
text:
What appears to be an iron helmet is actually
hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill
of battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_864_000
text:
Its shell is overflowing with its heightened
otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as
protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_865_000
text:
Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles
can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s
leek withers, it will retire from combat.

label: ZKN_SWORD_866_000
text:
It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane
of ice in time with its graceful movements.

label: ZKN_SWORD_867_000
text:
A powerful curse was woven into an ancient
painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask,
the painting began to move.

label: ZKN_SWORD_868_000
text:
This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling
particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_000
text:
When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to
berries it’s decorated with cream.

label: ZKN_SWORD_870_000
text:
Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass.
The brass’s orders are absolute.

label: ZKN_SWORD_871_000
text:
It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it
off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of
its spines.

label: ZKN_SWORD_872_000
text:
It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of
energy and uses it to tie its body to branches,
disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

label: ZKN_SWORD_873_000
text:
Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies
over fields and mountains. The temperature of its
wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_874_000
text:
It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent
from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent
for delivering dynamic kicks.

label: ZKN_SWORD_875_000
text:
It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a
frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to
make sure it stays nice and cold.

label: ZKN_SWORD_876_000
text:
It uses the horns on its head to sense the
emotions of others. Males will act as valets for
those they serve, looking after their every need.

label: ZKN_SWORD_877_000
text:
As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like
pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its
constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.

label: ZKN_SWORD_878_000
text:
It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very
strong, being able to carry loads of over
five tons without any problem at all.

label: ZKN_SWORD_879_000
text:
They came over from another region long
ago and worked together with humans.
Their green skin is resistant to water.

label: ZKN_SWORD_880_000
text:
In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its
powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway
after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

label: ZKN_SWORD_881_000
text:
The shaking of its freezing upper half is what
generates its electricity. It has a hard time
walking around.

label: ZKN_SWORD_882_000
text:
Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator
of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was
what drove it to extinction.

label: ZKN_SWORD_883_000
text:
Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its
surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey
afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

label: ZKN_SWORD_884_000
text:
Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both
lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that
it rusts easily.

label: ZKN_SWORD_885_000
text:
After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon,
Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit
back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

label: ZKN_SWORD_886_000
text:
It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph.
It battles alongside Dreepy and
dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

label: ZKN_SWORD_887_000
text:
When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the
holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches
the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

label: ZKN_SWORD_888_000
text:
Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon
absorbs metal particles, transforming them
into a weapon it uses to battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_889_000
text:
In times past, it worked together with a king of
the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs
metal that it then uses in battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_890_000
text:
The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating
from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is
what allows Eternatus to stay active.

label: ZKN_SWORD_891_000
text:
Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves
it masters will determine which form it takes when
it evolves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_892_000
text:
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the
one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes
and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

label: ZKN_SWORD_893_000
text:
Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack
with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive,
and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_894_000
text:
This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy.
It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s
body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_895_000
text:
An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s
arms were once the head of an ancient dragon
Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

label: ZKN_SWORD_896_000
text:
Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves.
It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it
wants, it takes by force.

label: ZKN_SWORD_897_000
text:
It probes its surroundings with all its senses save
one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s
kicks are said to separate soul from body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_898_000
text:
Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of
providing healing and blessings. It reigned over
the Galar region in times of yore.

label: ZKN_SWORD_003_999
text:
In battle, this Pokémon swings around two thick
vines. If these vines slammed into a 10-story
building, they could easily topple it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_006_999
text:
This colossal, flame-winged figure of a Charizard
was brought about by Gigantamax energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_009_999
text:
It’s not very good at precision shooting. When
attacking, it just fires its 31 cannons over and
over and over.

label: ZKN_SWORD_012_999
text:
Crystallized Gigantamax energy makes up this
Pokémon’s blindingly bright and highly
toxic scales.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_001
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
many different regions.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_002
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
the Hoenn region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_003
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
the Sinnoh region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_004
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
the Unova region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_005
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
the Kalos region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_006
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
the Alola region.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_007
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of when they first met.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_009
text:
This Pikachu wears its partner’s cap, which is
brimming with memories of traveling through
different regions.

label: ZKN_SWORD_025_999
text:
Its Gigantamax power expanded, forming its
supersized body and towering tail.

label: ZKN_SWORD_026_001
text:
It’s believed that the weather, climate, and food
of the Alola region all play a part in causing
Pikachu to evolve into this form of Raichu.

label: ZKN_SWORD_027_001
text:
Life on mountains covered with deep snow has
granted this Pokémon a body of ice that’s as hard
as steel.

label: ZKN_SWORD_028_001
text:
It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through
deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this
Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_037_001
text:
After long years in the ever-snowcapped
mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained
power over ice.

label: ZKN_SWORD_038_001
text:
A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this
Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped
as that deity’s incarnation.

label: ZKN_SWORD_050_001
text:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

label: ZKN_SWORD_051_001
text:
Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of
protective helmet on their heads, and they also
function as highly precise sensors.

label: ZKN_SWORD_052_001
text:
It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live
with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky
about food.

label: ZKN_SWORD_052_002
text:
Living with a savage, seafaring people has
toughened this Pokémon’s body so much that
parts of it have turned to iron.

label: ZKN_SWORD_052_999
text:
The pattern that has appeared on its giant coin
is thought to be the key to unlocking the secrets
of the Dynamax phenomenon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_053_001
text:
The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to
be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so
these Pokémon are very well cared for.

label: ZKN_SWORD_068_999
text:
The Gigantamax energy coursing through its arms
makes its punches hit as hard as bomb blasts.

label: ZKN_SWORD_077_001
text:
Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few
rubs from this Pokémon’s horn, any slight wound
you have will be healed.

label: ZKN_SWORD_078_001
text:
Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed
from this Pokémon’s horn, the move will punch
a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

label: ZKN_SWORD_079_001
text:
Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out,
its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion.
The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke’s diet.

label: ZKN_SWORD_080_002
text:
A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with
the spices inside Slowbro’s body, causing
Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_083_001
text:
The Farfetch’d of the Galar region are brave
warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks
in battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_094_999
text:
Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not
into its body, filled with cursed energy, but
instead directly to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SWORD_099_999
text:
The flow of Gigantamax energy has spurred this
Pokémon’s left pincer to grow to an enormous
size. That claw can pulverize anything.

label: ZKN_SWORD_103_001
text:
Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form
and powers of this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_105_001
text:
This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and
dances through the night as a way to mourn its
fallen allies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_110_001
text:
This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate
the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels
clean air.

label: ZKN_SWORD_122_001
text:
Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate
temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this
Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

label: ZKN_SWORD_131_999
text:
Over 5,000 people can ride on its shell at once.
And it’s a very comfortable ride, without the
slightest shaking or swaying.

label: ZKN_SWORD_133_999
text:
Gigantamax energy upped the fluffiness of the
fur around Eevee’s neck. The fur will envelop a
foe, capturing its body and captivating its mind.

label: ZKN_SWORD_143_999
text:
Gigantamax energy has affected stray seeds and
even pebbles that got stuck to Snorlax, making
them grow to a huge size.

label: ZKN_SWORD_144_001
text:
Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic
energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as
if they were paper.

label: ZKN_SWORD_145_001
text:
When its feathers rub together, they produce a
crackling sound like the zapping of electricity.
That’s why this Pokémon is called Zapdos.

label: ZKN_SWORD_146_001
text:
This Pokémon’s sinister, flame-like aura will
consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims
become burned-out shadows of themselves.

label: ZKN_SWORD_199_001
text:
A combination of toxins and the shock of
evolving has increased Shellder’s intelligence to
the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

label: ZKN_SWORD_222_001
text:
Watch your step when wandering areas oceans
once covered. What looks like a stone could be
this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_263_001
text:
Its restlessness has it constantly running around.
If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run
into them in order to start a fight.

label: ZKN_SWORD_264_001
text:
It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents.
Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls
itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

label: ZKN_SWORD_421_001
text:
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes
this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this,
and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

label: ZKN_SWORD_422_001
text:
There’s speculation that its appearance is
determined by what it eats, but the truth
remains elusive.

label: ZKN_SWORD_423_001
text:
It secretes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
This fluid isn’t poisonous—instead, it’s super
sticky, and once it sticks, it’s very hard to unstick.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_001
text:
This Rotom has possessed a convection
microwave oven that uses a special motor.
It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_002
text:
This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water-
based pranks. Be careful with it if you don’t want
your room flooded.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_003
text:
Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a
refrigerator powered by a special motor.
It battles by spewing cold air.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_004
text:
In this form, Rotom applies its new power over
wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow
away any important documents it can find.

label: ZKN_SWORD_479_005
text:
This is Rotom after it’s seized control of a lawn
mower that has a special motor. As it mows
down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

label: ZKN_SWORD_550_001
text:
Blue-striped Basculin used to be a common food
source. They apparently have an inoffensive,
light flavor.

label: ZKN_SWORD_554_001
text:
It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac
cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ
that generates cold instead.

label: ZKN_SWORD_555_001
text:
Through meditation, it calms its raging spirit and
hones its psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SWORD_555_002
text:
On days when blizzards blow through, it comes
down to where people live. It stashes food in the
snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

label: ZKN_SWORD_555_003
text:
Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac.
This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it
rampages indiscriminately.

label: ZKN_SWORD_562_001
text:
A clay slab with cursed engravings took
possession of a Yamask. The slab is said
to be absorbing the Yamask’s dark power.

label: ZKN_SWORD_569_999
text:
Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon’s toxic
gas has become much thicker, congealing into
masses shaped like discarded toys.

label: ZKN_SWORD_618_001
text:
Living in mud with a high iron content has given it
a strong steel body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_646_001
text:
The sameness of Reshiram’s and Kyurem’s genes
allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can
now use the power of both fire and ice.

label: ZKN_SWORD_646_002
text:
It’s said that this Pokémon battles in order to
protect the ideal world that will exist in the
future for people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_647_001
text:
Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle,
filling its body with power and changing its form.

label: ZKN_SWORD_678_001
text:
Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive
than males. If they don’t get what they want,
they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

label: ZKN_SWORD_681_001
text:
This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave
any opponent with the strength and weight of its
steel blade.

label: ZKN_SWORD_710_001
text:
When taking spirits to the afterlife, small
Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to
those of adults.

label: ZKN_SWORD_710_002
text:
When taking spirits to the afterlife, large
Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to
those of children.

label: ZKN_SWORD_710_003
text:
Supersized Pumpkaboo are very partial to
the spirits of people who were of similarly
superior proportions.

label: ZKN_SWORD_711_001
text:
Small Gourgeist pretend to be children to fool
adults. Anyone who falls for the act gets carried
away to the hereafter.

label: ZKN_SWORD_711_002
text:
Large Gourgeist put on the guise of adults,
taking the hands of children to lead them to
the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SWORD_711_003
text:
Supersized Gourgeist aren’t picky. They will
forcefully drag anyone off to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SWORD_744_001
text:
This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its
Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising
a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

label: ZKN_SWORD_745_001
text:
This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges
headlong at its opponents, attacking without any
care about what injuries it might receive.

label: ZKN_SWORD_745_002
text:
This form of Lycanroc is normally calm and quiet.
Once a battle begins, however, this Pokémon
displays a ferocious fighting spirit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_746_001
text:
On their own, they’re very weak. But when
Wishiwashi pool their power together in a
school, they become a demon of the sea.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_001
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Fighting type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_002
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Flying type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_003
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Poison type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_004
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Ground type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_005
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Rock type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_006
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Bug type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_007
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Ghost type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_008
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Steel type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_009
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Fire type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_010
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Water type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_011
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Grass type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_012
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Electric type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_013
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Psychic type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_014
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Ice type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_015
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Dragon type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_016
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Dark type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_773_017
text:
Thanks to its awakened powers, it can change to
the Fairy type to match the memory it
has equipped.

label: ZKN_SWORD_778_001
text:
There will be no forgiveness for any who reveal
that it was pretending to be Pikachu. It will bring
the culprit down, even at the cost of its own life.

label: ZKN_SWORD_800_001
text:
When it dominates Solgaleo, it takes on this
form. It’s a vicious Pokémon, mangling prey with
its many claws—including those on its back.

label: ZKN_SWORD_800_002
text:
Necrozma has subjugated Lunala entirely, forcing
the unfortunate Pokémon to emit its light energy
for Necrozma to consume.

label: ZKN_SWORD_809_999
text:
In a distant land, there are legends about a
cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal
that was flooded with Gigantamax energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_812_999
text:
Gigantamax energy has caused Rillaboom’s
stump to grow into a drum set that resembles
a forest.

label: ZKN_SWORD_815_999
text:
Infused with Cinderace’s fighting spirit, the
gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and
completely roasts opponents.

label: ZKN_SWORD_818_999
text:
Gigantamax Inteleon’s Water Gun move fires at
Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the
crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

label: ZKN_SWORD_823_999
text:
Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can
whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane
could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

label: ZKN_SWORD_826_999
text:
Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has
the rest of its body. This Pokémon’s intellect and
psychic abilities are overpowering.

label: ZKN_SWORD_834_999
text:
It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming
bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes,
and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

label: ZKN_SWORD_839_999
text:
Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax
energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon’s flame
burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SWORD_841_999
text:
Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it
produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape
has changed to resemble a giant apple.

label: ZKN_SWORD_842_999
text:
It blasts its opponents with massive amounts
of sweet, sticky nectar, drowning them under
the deluge.

label: ZKN_SWORD_844_999
text:
Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous
proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand
now swirl around its body.

label: ZKN_SWORD_845_001
text:
Cramorant’s gluttony led it to try to swallow an
Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant
getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

label: ZKN_SWORD_845_002
text:
This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu
lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little,
but it isn’t really bothered.

label: ZKN_SWORD_849_001
text:
Capable of generating 15,000 volts of
electricity, this Pokémon looks down on
all that would challenge it.

label: ZKN_SWORD_849_999
text:
Its excessive electric energy is its weapon.
This Pokémon can build up more electricity
than any thundercloud.

label: ZKN_SWORD_851_999
text:
Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body
temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees
Fahrenheit. Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

label: ZKN_SWORD_854_001
text:
The swirl pattern in this Pokémon’s body is
its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses
its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_855_001
text:
Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to
experience its distinctive flavor and aroma
firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

label: ZKN_SWORD_858_999
text:
This Pokémon can read the emotions of creatures
over 30 miles away. The minute it senses hostility,
it goes on the attack.

label: ZKN_SWORD_861_999
text:
By transforming its leg hair, this Pokémon delivers
power-packed drill kicks that can bore huge
holes in Galar’s terrain.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_001
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a sweet and
tart flavor. This is because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_002
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on an aromatic
flavor. This is because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_003
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a refreshing
flavor. This is because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_004
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a sour flavor.
This is because of the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_005
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a salty flavor.
This is because of the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_006
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a mixed
flavor. This is because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_007
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a bitter flavor.
This is because of the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_008
text:
The moment it evolved, it took on a complex
flavor. This is because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.

label: ZKN_SWORD_869_999
text:
Cream pours endlessly from this Pokémon’s body.
The cream stiffens when compressed by an
impact. A harder impact results in harder cream.

label: ZKN_SWORD_875_001
text:
The ice covering this Pokémon’s face has
shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression
that many people are enamored with.

label: ZKN_SWORD_876_001
text:
These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with
each other to share information between them.

label: ZKN_SWORD_877_001
text:
Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence,
and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted
into a Dark-type energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_879_999
text:
So much power is packed within its trunk that if it
were to unleash that power, the resulting blast
could level mountains and change the landscape.

label: ZKN_SWORD_884_999
text:
It’s grown to resemble a skyscraper. Parts of
its towering body glow due to a profusion
of energy.

label: ZKN_SWORD_888_001
text:
Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient
times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike
to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SWORD_889_001
text:
Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being
known as the Fighting Master’s Shield.
It was feared and respected by all.

label: ZKN_SWORD_890_001
text:
As a result of Rose’s meddling, Eternatus
absorbed all the energy in the Galar region.
It’s now in a state of power overload.

label: ZKN_SWORD_890_999
text:
As a result of Rose’s meddling, Eternatus
absorbed all the energy in the Galar region.
It’s now in a state of power overload.

label: ZKN_SWORD_892_001
text:
It’s believed that this Pokémon modeled its
fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes
rapid, sometimes calm.

label: ZKN_SWORD_892_999
text:
People call it the embodiment of rage. It’s said
that this Pokémon’s terrifying expression and
shout will rid the world of malevolence.

label: ZKN_SWORD_892_998
text:
As it waits for the right moment to unleash its
Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a
perfect one-legged stance. It won’t even twitch.

label: ZKN_SWORD_893_001
text:
This Zarude left its pack to raise a human child.
The cloth Zarude would wrap the child with has a
comforting scent that calmed the child’s crying.

label: ZKN_SWORD_898_001
text:
According to lore, this Pokémon showed no
mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would
heal its opponents’ wounds after battle.

label: ZKN_SWORD_898_002
text:
It’s said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that had
bonded with it ran all across the Galar region to
bring green to the wastelands.
